findings.description: Any full round (merge from base, rebase or force-push, `@claude review full`, a comment re-run on a reviewed head) drops every carried important. prior_importants is incremental-only and reviewers are told not to re-raise open threads, so that round prints "No issues found." and the next incremental round, keyed off the full record, has nothing left to carry.
findings.body:
**A full round breaks the carry-forward chain.**

Carrying only works between incremental rounds. §3 reads the prior record only under `mode = incremental`:

> - **Prior importants** (mode = incremental): read the prior record the Mode line names ... and so are the `unresolved` entries of its own `prior_importants` (an important a clean round did not re-raise stays owed until a head resolves it).

§9 (L168) and the schema description (`review-metrics.schemas.ts` L113) both say `prior_importants` is "empty on full".

The preflight picks full mode on common paths (`tools/review/src/preflight.utils.ts` `decideMode`):

```ts
if (prior.commit_sha === headSha) {
  return trigger === "comment" ? { kind: "full" } : ...
}
if (forceFull) return { kind: "full" };
if (!isAncestor || hasMerges) return { kind: "full" };
```

Those paths are a merge from the base branch (this PR has one, `6ddc4f1`), a rebase or force-push, `@claude review full`, and a comment re-run on a head that was already reviewed. Only the incremental line names a prior record (`review-preflight.script.ts:211`).

In a full round, nothing tells the orchestrator that a still-open important exists. The important lives in an inline thread, and §3 says that under CI "inline review threads and their resolution are out of reach". It survives only if a reviewer happens to find the bug again. If none does, `prior_importants` is `[]`, `carriedLines` returns nothing, and `bodyLines` prints `No issues found.`, which is the symptom this PR sets out to fix. The next incremental round then uses this full record as its prior (`newestCleanRecord`). That record holds neither the finding nor a carried entry, so the important is lost for good. That breaks the new promise in §3 that it "stays owed until a head resolves it" and the one in §9: "Copy every still-unresolved entry forward, round after round, or a clean round hides it".

One way to close the gap: have the preflight also emit the newest clean record's path when it resolves to full. The full round then carries that record's importants and unresolved `prior_importants` into `prior_importants` the same way an incremental round does. Then drop "empty on full" from §9 and from the schema description.

findings.description: The test commit 58dbef2 added ('keeps listing it when the next round copies the unresolved entries forward') builds round 2 with the test-only helper `unresolvedPrior(round1)`, so it passes with 58dbef2's schema-description and SKILL.md changes reverted. The orchestrator does the actual carrying by following that prose, which no test covers. The test only re-checks that one unresolved entry renders, which the first test in the block already asserts.
